page.notes: The scan shows a small filled dot in the left margin beside the heading "Ex speciosis Patrum nominibus" (a printer's mark, not transcribed). The words "acsi", "Gracorum", "Graeca" and "depromp[?]fisse" are doubtful at this resolution and are marked [?]. The margin label "SECT.V." is transcribed as a note. Quotation marks at the start of the small blocks are printed marks. "Cives" is printed "cines" in the scan and the reading is uncertain; "ciues" was read as "cives" in the text as printed letters "ci-more" line-break. Printed spelling "Graci", "praterea" and "Chrysostomus" retained as printed.
